subject: Procurement gate clarification & payment path for HelioMetrics
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@heliometrics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement questions from today's call

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo call today. Quick recap and two items I promised to clarify for your team on the procurement side:  

- Commercial preference: HelioMetrics mentioned the AP policy favors PO/invoice for SaaS spend and limits corporate card charges above $10k per transaction.
- Vendor onboarding: Procurement requires a completed vendor registration form (W-9 + banking details), SOC 2 Type II evidence for our hosted product, and a signed SOW/PO before first invoice.
- Marketplace option: You noted interest in marketplace (AWS/GCP) procurement if available — that would simplify procurement but may change pricing/discounting.

Next steps we propose:
1) I'll share a vendor form + a draft SOW and a one-page SOC2 summary for your security team.
2) If PO/net-30 is preferred, we can convert the estimate to an invoice and accept PO reference numbers; we need vendor registration completed first.
3) If Helio wants to pay by card for the pilot, we can accept a corporate card up to $10k; anything larger will require AP approval.

Attachments: HelioMetrics_VendorForm.pdf (blank vendor form) and Redwood_SOW_estimate.xlsx (high-level cost estimate).

Can you confirm the correct procurement contact and the typical lead time for vendor onboarding at HelioMetrics? Also curious whether marketplace procurement is a firm requirement or just a nice-to-have.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0193

On Thu, 20 May 2027 at 15:48, Samir Shah <samir@heliometrics.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Sergio — good session. I looped in procurement (procurement@heliometrics.com) so they see the ask.
>
> Quick answers from my side before I get procurement to respond formally:  
> - Vendor form and SOC2 will be required.
> - Our AP team will accept an invoice with a PO number for net-30 payment.
> - Corporate card payments are allowed but require finance approval for SaaS subscriptions > $10k.
> - Marketplace is preferred when available but not a hard blocker.
>
> I'm sending this to procurement now to give them the vendor form and ask for their typical lead times.
>
> Samir
> Head of Platform — HelioMetrics
> samir@heliometrics.com
>
From: HelioMetrics Procurement <procurement@heliometrics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@heliometrics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement gating & vendor setup — Redwood

Hi Sergio —

Procurement here. A few points and constraints so we can plan:  

1) Vendor requirements: completed vendor registration (W-9 for US vendors), banking details for ACH, and SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) evidence. We can accept a SOC2 summary and a read-only link to the report if under NDA.
2) Payment terms: standard is net-30 on receipt of invoice with an approved PO number. For pilots <$10k we can sometimes approve corporate card payment, but it requires a manager sign-off.
3) Marketplace: if Redwood is listed in the AWS Marketplace with meter-based billing, procurement will prefer that route since it avoids lengthy vendor setup. If not, invoice/PO is the default.
4) Special approval: if Redwood requires upfront prepayment for Dedicated capacity, route that request to finance with business justification — approvals can take 10–14 business days.

Estimated vendor setup timeline: 5–10 business days once we have a completed vendor form + SOC2 evidence. For signed SOW and PO issuance, allow an additional 3–5 business days.

Please send the vendor form and SOC2 summary to procurement@heliometrics.com and copy Samir.

Regards,
HelioMetrics Procurement Team
procurement@heliometrics.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — options for HelioMetrics payment path

Team — taking procurement's notes into account, quick recommendation:

- Option A (fastest, preferred): Invoice + PO (net-30). We provide vendor form + SOC2 summary today, SOW draft tomorrow. Estimated close timeline: 10–15 business days.
- Option B (pilot by card): If Samir can get manager sign-off for a card payment < $10k, we can start immediately and convert to PO for ongoing billing. Requires finance approval on their side.
- Option C (marketplace): Recommend pursuing AWS Marketplace listing as a long-term play; not fast enough for this pilot but reduces friction for expansion.

Action items:
- Sergio: Send vendor form & SOC2 summary to procurement@heliometrics.com (DONE).
- Mina: Prepare a one-page SOC2 summary and a minimal SOW that lists pilot scope and upgrade path (ETA EOD today).
- Laura: Prepare an invoice template that can include a PO reference and net-30 payment terms.

I'll coordinate if procurement asks for additional tax or compliance docs.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@heliometrics.com>, procurement@heliometrics.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement gate clarification & payment path for HelioMetrics

Samir / Procurement — thanks for the clear notes. Attaching the vendor form (blank) and the SOW estimate for the pilot. Mina also attached the SOC2 one-pager to the DocuSign link below for secure access.

To recap and propose a path for the pilot:
- If HelioMetrics can issue a PO with net-30, we'll proceed with invoice-based billing; we can start provisioning once the vendor form is returned and PO is issued.
- If you prefer to start immediately and the pilot value is below $10k, a corporate card payment is an acceptable short-term route — please confirm manager sign-off.
- Marketplace enrollment: we’ll flag this for our partnerships team; if you want us to prioritize AWS listing, say so and we'll open a parallel track (timeline: 6–8 weeks).

Next steps (agreed):
1) Procurement: confirm vendor form recipient + expected PO number format.
2) Helio: return vendor form + indicate whether pilot will be card or PO.
3) Redwood (Mina): upload SOC2 one-page and full vendor pack to DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcdef-helio-invoice).
4) Redwood (Laura): send invoice template with PO field ready.

If these items look right, Samir — can you confirm which payment path you want us to prioritize?

Best,
Sergio
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
